_help: HAND-MAINTAINED. 'pnpm scrape' never writes this file.
The FMS does not publish operating hours, so guessing them into the
scraped graph would be fabricating facts. Fill them in here instead.
Times are SGT (UTC+8, no DST), 24-hour HH:MM.
["07:00", "01:00"]   fine - a window may cross midnight
null                 does NOT run that day
An unfilled or malformed window is treated as UNKNOWN, and an unknown
service is assumed to be running. That is the safe direction to fail, but
it means the 'ended' rung never fires: the tile will cheerfully offer you
a bus at 03:00. Filling these in is what turns 'No bus - walk 21 min'
from dead code into a real answer.
You only need the services you actually use. Leaving one unfilled costs
nothing except that it never reports 'ended'.
